comparison.objective: Secure a housing in a rollover fixture, invert and lock it, then install a wear pad.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequential fixture loading, retention-bar operation, controlled inversion, bolt actuation, and pad insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Housing secured and inverted, bolt home, pad seated, all parts retained, and both hands clear while still.
comparison.reason: Although both manipulate a supported object bimanually and finish released, fixture inversion and component installation do not test loose-body aperture separation. No material rubric details are missing.
